title: Transformational artificial-intelligence models for science and engineering
last_action: Enacted as section 50404 of Public Law 119-21.
summary: Directs the Department of Energy to mobilize national laboratories and industry partners to curate scientific data and support transformational AI models, with security and privacy requirements for shared research infrastructure.
committee_dynamics: The provision moved in a large reconciliation law and is included as adjacent federal capacity with security-relevant data controls.
advance_rationale: Enacted law; implementation replaces advancement forecasting.

agency_status.detail: DOE has publicized the Transformational AI Models Consortium and related implementation activity; this record does not treat those materials as proof that every statutory element is complete.

verification_level: Official law and DOE implementation material verified.
